propositions: No aggregated lens exists for 344 closed bugs across five dimensions: close_class distribution, detected_by channel, open-bug age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close; trend analysis requires ad-hoc scripts.
Pre-convention bugs lack close_class field (~214 bugs); the lens must surface this MISSING cohort as an explicit labeled bucket alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent era mixing.
The detected_by field is sparse (not yet populated everywhere); the lens must degrade gracefully, marking that dimension unavailable without affecting others.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within ctx range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, fan-in) are point-in-time and deliberately ignore range.

Unit and held-out tests (21/21 green) verify happy path, empty stores, mixed eras, sparse fields, range semantics, percentiles, and registry label correctness; real-store smoke shows correct era skew surfacing and honest unavailability reporting.
